titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Świat przyrody — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: The Natural World — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Świat przyrody: pogoda, krajobraz, zwierzęta, ekologia. Listy do gier LingoSpark.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Natural world module: weather, landscape, animals, the environment. Paste into LingoSpark games.

items.definitionEn: a report that says what the weather will be
items.example: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow afternoon.

items.definitionEn: with a lot of cloud and little sun
items.example: It was cloudy all morning, then the sun came out.

items.definitionEn: with thick cloud near the ground that is hard to see through
items.example: The road was dangerous because it was so foggy.

items.definitionEn: a flash of light in the sky during a storm
items.example: We saw lightning over the lake.

items.definitionEn: the loud noise that follows lightning
items.example: The thunder woke the baby.

items.definitionEn: frozen rain that falls as small balls of ice
items.example: Hail hit the car roof during the storm.

items.definitionEn: a long time with little or no rain
items.example: Farmers lost crops because of the drought.

items.definitionEn: water covering land that is usually dry
items.example: The river burst its banks and caused a flood.

items.definitionEn: a very strong tropical storm with fast winds
items.example: A hurricane damaged houses on the coast.

items.definitionEn: the usual weather in a place over many years
items.example: Poland has a temperate climate with four seasons.

items.definitionEn: the air, water, land and living things around us
items.example: We must protect the environment for the next generation.

items.definitionEn: dirty air, water or land caused by people
items.example: Car fumes cause pollution in the city centre.

items.definitionEn: to turn used materials into new products
items.example: We recycle paper, glass and plastic at home.

items.definitionEn: things you throw away
items.example: Do not throw rubbish into the river.

items.definitionEn: rubbish left on the ground in a public place
items.example: Please pick up your litter after the picnic.

items.definitionEn: at risk of disappearing as a species
items.example: Tigers are an endangered species.

items.definitionEn: no longer existing as a species
items.example: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.

items.definitionEn: animals and plants living in nature, not kept by people
items.example: The forest is full of wildlife in spring.

items.definitionEn: the natural place where an animal or plant lives
items.example: Cutting trees destroys the habitat of many birds.

items.definitionEn: a thick, wet forest in a hot part of the world
items.example: Many rare animals live in the rainforest.

items.definitionEn: a very dry area with little rain
items.example: Camels can travel across the desert for days.

items.definitionEn: a piece of land with water all around it
items.example: We spent a week on a small Greek island.

items.definitionEn: low land between hills or mountains
items.example: A river runs through the valley.

items.definitionEn: a place where a river falls from a high point
items.example: We took photos of the waterfall from the bridge.

items.definitionEn: a mountain that can send out hot rock and ash
items.example: The volcano has not erupted for a hundred years.

items.definitionEn: a sudden, strong shaking of the ground
items.example: The earthquake damaged several old buildings.

items.definitionEn: to keep someone or something safe from harm
items.example: National parks protect rare plants and animals.

items.definitionEn: the slow rise in the Earth's temperature
items.example: Global warming is melting ice in the polar regions.

items.definitionEn: gases in the air that trap heat from the sun
items.example: The greenhouse effect is stronger because of extra carbon dioxide.

items.definitionEn: power from the sun, wind or water that will not run out
items.example: Wind farms produce renewable energy.

items.definitionEn: a group of animals or plants of the same kind
items.example: This species of bird lives only in wetlands.

items.definitionEn: an animal that does not live with people as a pet
items.example: Never feed a wild animal in the national park.

items.definitionEn: a small animal with six legs, such as a bee or ant
items.example: A bee is an insect that helps plants make fruit.

items.definitionEn: a living thing that grows in soil, such as a tree or flower
items.example: Water the plant twice a week.

items.definitionEn: the time when crops are collected; to collect them
items.example: Farmers harvest apples in September.

items.definitionEn: one of the four parts of the year with typical weather
items.example: My favourite season is autumn because of the colours.
